interface Order {
  id: string;
}

export class FakeOrderRepository {
  private readonly orders = new Map<string, Order>();
  private saves = 0;
  readonly name = 'fake';
  async save(order: Order): Promise<void> {
    this.saves += 1;
    this.orders.set(order.id, order);
  }
  async find(id: string): Promise<Order | undefined> {
    return this.orders.get(id);
  }

  count(): number {
    return this.saves;
  }
  get size(): number {
    return this.orders.size;
  }
  static create(): FakeOrderRepository {
    return new FakeOrderRepository();
  }
}
